summary: Completed comprehensive testing of HealthPRO Healthcare Institute Management features. 25/25 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend testing verified: Login, Dashboard, Employees page, Overtime dialog with calculation verification, and Visitors tab. All CRUD operations and overtime calculations working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: All HealthPRO APIs properly implement tenant isolation via tenant_id
Role-based access control working correctly (admin can create/edit, visitor is read-only)
Overtime calculation formula correctly implemented: hours * (salary/176) * coefficient
Overtime coefficients: normal=1.25, night=1.5, weekend=1.5, holiday=2.0
Visitor role properly restricts write operations (returns 403 for non-admin)
Monthly overtime summary aggregates all overtime types correctly
seed_data_creation: Test data created during testing: TEST_Calc Employee (€800), TEST_Maria Krasniqi (€800), TEST_Update Employee (€750), TEST_Delete Employee. Existing data: Maria Krasniqi (€800), Admin Test, Arben Gashi (visitor). Overtime entries created for calculation verification.
